digest.component_or_area: rebar project criterion framework; code-review review-phase-boundaries
propositions: Criterion must enforce four distinct review phases with clear ownership: Pass 1 finds candidates only, Pass 2 verifies atomically, Pass 3 routes deterministically, Pass 4 coaches non-prescriptively.

Criterion must emit grounded findings for phase-boundary violations (severity/confidence leakage, new findings, LLM discretion, remediation in Pass 1, policy decisions in Pass 1, re-adjudication in Pass 4) while abstaining on legitimate phase refinements.

Balanced evaluation corpus with 12 cases (RP-F1..F6 must fire, RP-N1..N6 must abstain) must achieve recall=1.0, false_accept=0.0, agreement=1.0, stability_min≥2/3, and kappa≥0.70 across three calibration runs.
Project-owned routing, prompt, eval, tests, and docs must be committed to main with only declared asset paths changed and live operator-attested calibration evidence recorded.
